hyperedges.label: rKeyChat two-lane architecture: live messages, sealed archive, rKey membership
Pear Threads: rKeyChat records and UI extracted for PearDrive file comments
PearDrive onto new pearcore: coupling map → patch set upstreamed → adapter → lab run

nodes.label: rkeychat Daemon
nodes.rationale: One Node daemon per machine joins the room's pearcore space and hosts participants; the machine's pearcore key only carries traffic, identity comes from rKey participant keys.

nodes.label: Participant (rKey chat-scope key)
nodes.rationale: Each participant has its own key enrolled under Guy's rKey root with the chat scope; every message is signed and membership checked against the chain on every message.

nodes.label: Live lane (pearcore MessageService)
nodes.rationale: Reuses pearcore MessageService which already signs, encrypts with the space secret and relays. Envelope {app:'rkeychat', v:0, type}; PearDrive ignores it because the app tag doesn't match.

nodes.label: Live message types (msg, chain, hist-req/res, presence, control)
nodes.norm_label: live message types (msg, chain, hist-req/res, presence, control)

nodes.label: Durable lane (hash-chained archive)
nodes.rationale: Sealed, immutable per-day files so PearDrive never churns re-hashing a growing file; day header {v, room, day, prev, count, root} links days into a tamper-evident chain; month/year rollups keep the reader's index small.

nodes.label: Archivist (room-owner device)
nodes.rationale: The room-owner device writes the archive because it has everything after sync; other devices only verify.

nodes.label: Hermes bridge
nodes.rationale: Uses Hermes' local API server (127.0.0.1:8642), one session per room; new messages are batched, POSTed to /api/sessions/{id}/chat/stream, reply streamed back and posted.

nodes.label: Claude Code bridge (tail/wait under Monitor, send)
nodes.rationale: Each line from rkeychat tail wakes the Claude session via the Monitor tool; fallback is claude -p --resume.
nodes.norm_label: claude code bridge (tail/wait under monitor, send)

nodes.label: Turn-taking and round budget
nodes.rationale: A message from Guy resets the budget; each agent-to-agent reply spends a round; at 0 agents stop until Guy posts or extends. Default 3 autonomous rounds, extendable +N, until a time, or unlimited; one turn at a time per agent with batching while busy.

nodes.label: PearDrive transfer fallback to pearcore native protocol
nodes.rationale: PearDrive only downloads over its own 0x03 lane so it cannot pull files from a plain pearcore peer; without a fallback it can serve rKeyChat history but not back it up.
nodes.norm_label: peardrive transfer fallback to pearcore native protocol

nodes.label: Retire src/engine/agent.js (Agent Mesh)
nodes.rationale: Superseded by rKeyChat; Guy's verdict: nobody used it, he couldn't see inside it, and he still had to copy-paste between agents.

nodes.label: rkeychat CLI (init, add, start, join, request, invite, status, wait, send)
nodes.norm_label: rkeychat cli (init, add, start, join, request, invite, status, wait, send)

nodes.label: Invite / request / approve enrollment flow
nodes.rationale: A new machine joins with an invite, runs rkeychat request to print an rkr1 code, and the owner pastes it into GUI Keys/Approve; machine and agent are enrolled and can talk immediately.

nodes.label: pearcore is the foundation, PearDrive one client
nodes.rationale: Guy wants many small single-purpose apps (chat, calendar, channels) on pearcore that must not depend on PearDrive internals; anything generic (transfers, streaming, access control, identity) belongs in pearcore.
nodes.norm_label: pearcore is the foundation, peardrive one client

nodes.label: App spaces (.pearmeta/app.json)
nodes.rationale: PearDrive recognises an app manifest (owner-only trust, same rule as spaceInfo), shows an Apps rail group, isolates app data from feed/thumbnails/stats, and its main job is seeding/backup so apps get durable history from any PearDrive device.

nodes.label: rKey identity layer
nodes.rationale: Keys sign for keys, revocably, with signatures in both directions; pearcore account keys are enrolled as host devices under a user's root and space whitelists are derived from the chain.

nodes.label: Port PearDrive's transfer lane into pearcore as the engine
nodes.rationale: pearcore native loses nearly everything that makes streaming work (16 MB requests, 64 s stall reclaim, no cancel/seek, download-to-disk only, full tree round trip first). Don't keep two engines: byte-range read, small per-peer windows, per-reqId cancel, playhead cursor, sparse partial store, priority tiers, supersede epochs, leaf hashes up front, control-plane mux priority, benching with decay, per-seeder accounting, drain timeout.
nodes.norm_label: port peardrive's transfer lane into pearcore as the engine

nodes.label: pearcore bug: SocketManager drops live peers after dedupe
nodes.rationale: resetSocket unindexes without destroying; if the newer socket closes, removeSocket deletes the whole peer record so sends are silently skipped. Observed in rKeyChat 2026-09-29 (A→B controls lost). Workaround: Room #healSockets re-registers orphaned connections every 20 s.
nodes.norm_label: pearcore bug: socketmanager drops live peers after dedupe

nodes.label: pearcore bug: canonicalStringify emits invalid JSON for undefined
nodes.rationale: Encrypted payloads with undefined fields fail JSON.parse on the receiver and are dropped silently with content:null; cost hours because disk-reloaded records had no undefined keys. Workaround: proto.js clean/envelope JSON-round-trips every payload.
nodes.norm_label: pearcore bug: canonicalstringify emits invalid json for undefined

nodes.label: Growing files are pathological for PearDrive
nodes.rationale: Each change re-hashes the whole file and mints a new variant, stranding in-flight tasks; so apps must write sealed segments, or pearcore needs an append-only Merkle-extendable file type.
nodes.norm_label: growing files are pathological for peardrive

nodes.label: Per-file / per-folder access: separate transport from access (Cryptree-style keys)
nodes.rationale: Spaces move ciphertext, keys grant access, so any of 1000 seeders can serve chunks without reading them. Per-file content keys, folder keys wrapped under parent FK, grants as capability records wrapped to rKey-bound X25519 keys, channel epoch keys for subscriptions, Lightning-atomic key release for selling a file. Prior art: Cryptree/Wuala, Tahoe-LAFS, Peergos.
nodes.norm_label: per-file / per-folder access: separate transport from access (cryptree-style keys)

nodes.label: Share by hash across spaces, one content store per device
nodes.rationale: Spaces hold references to hashes, not copies; a per-space exposure list stops hash probing; dedupe is free; content ids should be the pearcore Merkle root so the same file has one id in every app and streams from any seeder.
nodes.norm_label: share by hash across spaces, one content store per device

nodes.label: Moderation as a signed redact record
nodes.rationale: An admin posts {kind:'redact', target, hashes, reason}; the target is blanked everywhere and hashes join the block list (HTTP 410, blob requests ignored). Because redactions are ordinary signed records the moderation history is auditable and replicates like everything else. Suggested independently by Kimi.
nodes.norm_label: moderation as a signed redact record

nodes.label: Bare port of pearcore (rKeyChat-mobile/bare)
nodes.rationale: Runs pearcore unmodified on Bare via npm overrides (better-sqlite3→bare-sqlite, zlib→bare-zlib, shims for pino, chokidar, ws, qrcode); a pluggable storage/logging layer in pearcore would remove the overrides.

nodes.label: pearcore gap: file lists don't reach late peers
nodes.rationale: A node sends its file list only in reply to a direct space-sync; rKeyChat works around it with Room.announceFiles re-announcing via FileEventBroadcaster on peer connect.
nodes.norm_label: pearcore gap: file lists don't reach late peers

nodes.label: Phone as a paired browser on the tailnet
nodes.rationale: The Mac hosts; the phone pairs by QR (one-use, 10 min) that sets a year-long HttpOnly cookie; non-Mac requests need the cookie or get 401; managing access is Mac-only so a paired phone can't mint more phones. The phone posts as Guy through the Mac for now.
nodes.norm_label: phone as a paired browser on the tailnet

nodes.label: Phone layout (chat owns the screen, sheets for panels)
nodes.rationale: Title bar and dock gone, sidebar becomes its own screen, room header collapses to a ⋯ menu, agent strip hidden unless it needs you, panels become full-screen sheets, long-press to react, 16px composer text to avoid iOS zoom.
nodes.norm_label: phone layout (chat owns the screen, sheets for panels)

nodes.label: Live dictation pipe (/api/live WebSocket → Parakeet on the Mac)
nodes.rationale: Phone captures 16 kHz mono PCM, streams over /api/live, Mac runs Parakeet in-process and streams partials back; same pipe as desktop. iOS only allows the mic in a secure context, so HTTPS via tailscale serve is required and the phone must re-pair since the https origin is a different site.
nodes.norm_label: live dictation pipe (/api/live websocket → parakeet on the mac)

nodes.label: Mac Mini update procedure (rkeychat-kit)
nodes.rationale: Fixes 'messages don't arrive': pearcore silently dropped chat messages with an empty optional field.

nodes.label: Pear Thread (signed records hanging off a subject)
nodes.rationale: A chat room is just a thread whose subject is the room; PearDrive comments are threads whose subject is a file. Protocol, storage, reactions and UI are the same code. By the Pear UI rule, the second consumer (PearDrive) justifies extracting it now.
nodes.norm_label: pear thread (signed records hanging off a subject)

nodes.label: Record kinds (msg, react, redact, activity)
nodes.rationale: Every record is signed by its author's rKey key and verified against the space's chain so it is trusted when relayed or replayed. Reactions are toggled, last toggle per author/emoji wins. Activity is an agent side channel shown to people and never fed to agents. Rule: strip undefined fields before signing or sending.

nodes.label: Nostr mapping (NIP-22, NIP-25, NIP-73, NIP-94)
nodes.rationale: Shapes are chosen to map 1:1 onto Nostr events so mirroring later is mechanical; rKey's domain-separated signature stays the source of truth and a Nostr mirror is a re-encoding, not a second authority.

nodes.label: Pear UI elements (pear-ui.css / pear-ui.js)
nodes.rationale: Message bubble with continuation grouping, reaction row on the bubble's bottom edge, emoji picker, who-reacted popover, verified lock, detail/thinking overlay, composer with dictation mic and voice memo.

nodes.label: src/lib/pearcore.js single import surface
nodes.rationale: The only PearDrive file naming a pearcore path; deep imports because the package main points at a non-existent file.

nodes.label: PearDrive Catalog (persistent twin of spaceFileList)
nodes.rationale: Adds persistence, offline providers, per-provider deleted state, owner purges, tombstones, device roster, revision ring and a content-identity index that pearcore's in-memory per-session SpaceFileListManager lacks.

nodes.label: scripts/patch-pearcore.mjs (install-time patch set)
nodes.rationale: 868-line postinstall patching the installed pearcore copy: §1 merkleTree case, §D file-list replay, §D2 boot rebroadcast, §I offline rows, §J non-blocking join, §K peerFilter, §N remove emptiness, §P pino error, §Q hash-once, §V sodium verify, §W inert watcher.

nodes.label: PearDrive 0x03 control lane + STREAM data plane
nodes.rationale: Exists because only the JSON lane throttles; 256 KiB leaf unit, 8 leaves per chunkReq, MAX_PEER_INFLIGHT=4 because the shared socket has no backpressure; PearDrive overwrites pearcore's STREAM handler.
nodes.norm_label: peardrive 0x03 control lane + stream data plane

nodes.label: Priority tiers (INTERACTIVE / SELECTED / BACKGROUND) and viewer epochs
nodes.rationale: A starved interactive job owns the pipe exclusively until buffered; displacement by epoch is coolDown, never teardown.
nodes.norm_label: priority tiers (interactive / selected / background) and viewer epochs

nodes.label: Index quarantine / hash-once (prepare → commit)
nodes.rationale: Merkle trees are precomputed before the user commits and handed to localFileRegistry.add as {tree, metaHash}; new registry.add() dropped them, so §Q2 is a mandatory re-target or every file hashes twice.

nodes.label: Dedupe by hash (content-identity view, reclaim, cross-space reconnect)
nodes.rationale: Nothing stored or synced for the view; reclaim never touches the only local copy; cross-space reconnect registers content at the existing disk path with the tree read back from file_index.
nodes.norm_label: dedupe by hash (content-identity view, reclaim, cross-space reconnect)

nodes.label: Agent Mesh (src/engine/agent.js, AgentOps space)
nodes.rationale: A diagnostics mesh with no wire protocol: .pearmeta/agents/<host>/ mailboxes synced as ordinary files; heartbeat is derived state so same state yields same hash and silence; fixed read-only probe menu; cryptographic auth via signJSON against an admin set because provider attribution was bypassable.

nodes.label: StorageManager deleted upstream (29 call sites)
nodes.rationale: The single biggest break; replaced by free functions taking db, which as a bonus keep row ids.

nodes.label: Phase 1 plan (swap the storage layer, absorb ~15 upstream bugs)
nodes.rationale: Kimi's reframing: catalog, gossip, agent mesh, swarm manager and thumbnails have no pearcore equivalent and stay; fix §1, §I, §D/§D2, §Q2 in pearcore first, then an adapter in PearDrive for the StorageManager surface.
nodes.norm_label: phase 1 plan (swap the storage layer, absorb ~15 upstream bugs)

nodes.label: pearcore branch peardrive-phase1 (16 commits)
nodes.rationale: Each still-applying patch moved upstream as its own commit for Farzam; plus a new mux fix where a sync frame handler's TypeError dropped every following frame.

nodes.label: attachStorage / attachThrowingAdd adapter
nodes.rationale: Restores the StorageManager surface over free functions and makes add() throw again because PearDrive's LAW A ('already exists is an answer, not a success') depends on the throw at 8 sites; drizzle-orm no longer imported.

nodes.label: Phase 1 lab run (three nodes, public DHT)
nodes.norm_label: phase 1 lab run (three nodes, public dht)

nodes.label: Once-per-socket file list push (c60b6bb)
nodes.rationale: After the one push a peer stays current only through SpaceFileEvents which peerFilter can suppress; a PearDrive node mis-classifying a peer as a delta peer would starve it. This is the seam.

nodes.label: Non-blocking join (2fc0e8f)
nodes.rationale: space.create() now returns before the DHT announce lands; anything assuming created implies discoverable (rKeyChat login) must be re-read.

nodes.label: Space directories decoupled from disk
nodes.rationale: A space is its own root; space directories are signed records synced to members; a file is a link to content by hash, never a path; fixes the redundant folder inside every space, folder-name collisions across machines, and the 20 GB dedupe that made a second directory look empty.

nodes.label: Local index (hash → disk location, per device)
nodes.rationale: Stores hash, size, inode, volume id and a cheap fingerprint so moves self-heal via FSEvents/inotify; private paths never leave the device.
nodes.norm_label: local index (hash → disk location, per device)

nodes.label: Connection (watch folder → space directory; collect/mirror, flatten/subtree)
nodes.rationale: Many-to-many bridge between disk and space; collect (additions only) is the default because the space is the archive and the folder is just an inbox.
nodes.norm_label: connection (watch folder → space directory; collect/mirror, flatten/subtree)

nodes.label: dir-entry record
nodes.rationale: Guy dropped the per-entry versions list: a different hash is a different file; version history is a policy layer on top.

nodes.label: Names are labels on hashes; owner adopts canonical, others propose
nodes.rationale: Replaces last-writer-wins on names: a 10,000-member movie space can have 10,000 local naming schemes and one canonical index.
nodes.norm_label: names are labels on hashes; owner adopts canonical, others propose

nodes.label: Non-destructive, like a nonlinear editor
nodes.rationale: PearDrive never touches disk unless told; three distinct actions with escalating confirmation: remove from space, delete locally, delete from everywhere. Disconnects are normal, not errors.

nodes.label: Serve rule: serve hash H only through a space with a signed link and member peer
nodes.rationale: Hard protocol rule, not policy: global hash knowledge is never authorization. Closes the hash-oracle, presence-correlation, probing and malicious-claim cases in Kimi's threat model.
nodes.norm_label: serve rule: serve hash h only through a space with a signed link and member peer

nodes.label: Claim-based soft turn order for agents
nodes.rationale: The lead agent has a short window to post a hidden claim marker; silence passes the floor down the room's list, so there is no single point of silence.
nodes.norm_label: claim-based soft turn order for agents

nodes.label: Dock: Rooms · Contacts · Agents · Profile
nodes.rationale: Rooms is a flat recency-sorted list with search; the gear moves into Profile; Pause moves into room details; Keys becomes Profile.

nodes.label: Room details panel (right side, resizable; sheet on phone)
nodes.rationale: Reads like a profile page for the room: rename, purpose and answer order, People and Agents as separate lists with per-room pause/limit, conversation controls, invite/leave/remove.
nodes.norm_label: room details panel (right side, resizable; sheet on phone)

nodes.label: Identity model: one account root per person, device keys under it, agent roots per agent
nodes.rationale: Agent roots are minted by the hosting device and enrolled per room with agent + delegate scope; the agent root appends its own session-key enrollments so revoking it cascades and rotation needs no host. Banning an agent never touches your device keys. Enrollment is the attestation; the change is key custody and display rules.
nodes.norm_label: identity model: one account root per person, device keys under it, agent roots per agent

nodes.label: Roll keys in place as a live kick/invite test
nodes.norm_label: roll keys in place as a live kick/invite test

nodes.label: Posting-device badge (iPhone, desktop, PearDrive)
nodes.rationale: Shown to everyone while building, hidden behind hover later; lets client apps like PearDrive post into a room as Guy from their own device key.

nodes.label: Thumbnails for shared media as room blobs
nodes.norm_label: thumbnails for shared media as room blobs

nodes.label: Pearcast look (dark, one green accent, depth from light)
nodes.rationale: CSS tokens: dark surfaces, soft top highlights and long shadows, one green accent and one red; color-scheme dark; a single-file GUI with no framework.
nodes.norm_label: pearcast look (dark, one green accent, depth from light)

nodes.label: EventSource /api/events push stream
nodes.rationale: The daemon pushes every change; the page never polls. If the stream is quiet for a minute, one catch-up load then back to the stream. Events: rooms, room, record, participants, reactions, activity, agent-error, login-progress, login, fork, file-progress.

nodes.label: api() fetch helper and REST surface
nodes.rationale: Endpoints used: /api/state, /api/send, /api/control, /api/react, /api/redact, /api/rooms(+join/add), /api/invite, /api/request, /api/approve, /api/revoke, /api/unban, /api/people, /api/glossary(+learn), /api/settings, /api/remote(+enable/pair/revoke), /api/login/offer|claim, /api/files, /api/fetch, /api/file, /api/blob, /api/upload, /api/activity.
nodes.norm_label: api() fetch helper and rest surface

nodes.label: renderFeed (timeline bubbles, day lines, control lines, redactions)
nodes.rationale: Computes a signature of visible state and skips repaint when nothing changed so the reader stays where they are; keeps distance-from-bottom when re-rendering mid-read; continuation grouping within 5 minutes by the same author.
nodes.norm_label: renderfeed (timeline bubbles, day lines, control lines, redactions)

nodes.label: renderPanel / PAGES table / openPage
nodes.rationale: Pages: rooms, people, room, contacts, profile, agents, keys (Verified), activity, invite, settings. Never repaints the room page under an unsaved charter edit or mid-drag. On the phone a tab strip sits on top of the sheet.

nodes.label: renderRoomPage (room details: people/agents, key rows, remove/ban/unban, charter order)
nodes.norm_label: renderroompage (room details: people/agents, key rows, remove/ban/unban, charter order)

nodes.label: renderProfilePage (root, device, signing tree, hosted agents, log in new device QR, approve request)
nodes.rationale: One account, a key per device, all shown as you; the root lives on this Mac for now and moves to an NFC card later.
nodes.norm_label: renderprofilepage (root, device, signing tree, hosted agents, log in new device qr, approve request)

nodes.label: renderKeysPage (Verified: signature details, voice memo transcripts)
nodes.norm_label: renderkeyspage (verified: signature details, voice memo transcripts)

nodes.label: renderSide / renderHead / renderStrip / renderChrome
nodes.rationale: Rooms sidebar with unread markers (seen ts kept per device in localStorage), room header with faces and menu, agent strip with rounds and Pause.

nodes.label: Reaction row, picker, who-reacted popover, toggleReaction
nodes.norm_label: reaction row, picker, who-reacted popover, togglereaction

nodes.label: openThinking / activity overlay
nodes.rationale: Agent activity is shown to people only; it never goes into any agent's prompt so it costs no tokens.

nodes.label: startLiveDictation (16 kHz PCM over ws /api/live)
nodes.rationale: Audio streams to the daemon as you talk and text streams back into the composer; the final pass replaces the draft; learnFromEdits feeds the glossary from word diffs.

nodes.label: Voice memo recorder (startRecording, peaksOf, memoHTML, playMemo)
nodes.norm_label: voice memo recorder (startrecording, peaksof, memohtml, playmemo)

nodes.label: Files by hash (attachFile, getFile, openFile viewer, paintRing progress)
nodes.rationale: Open inside the app, always with a way out; nothing navigates the page. Get fetches by hash via /api/fetch, progress rings fill from file-progress events, Open renders image/video/audio/pdf/text inline.
nodes.norm_label: files by hash (attachfile, getfile, openfile viewer, paintring progress)

nodes.label: renderSettingsPage / phoneHTML (phone access, pairing, HTTPS switch)
nodes.norm_label: rendersettingspage / phonehtml (phone access, pairing, https switch)

nodes.label: Resizable panel and sidebar grips (localStorage widths)
nodes.norm_label: resizable panel and sidebar grips (localstorage widths)
